rule.rr_hottest_min_basis: The county's heat curve must show a heat effect: median model RR (harm/harm_daily_{fips}.csv rr) on the county's hottest 1% of days (tmean_c >= its 99th percentile) is at least 1.01.
rule.heat_per100k_min_basis: Heat deaths must be plausible: heat_attr_deaths_per_year (harm/harm_summary_{fips}.json) per 100k mean residents (data/processed/county_population_long.csv) is at least 1.0/yr, about a third of the published US benchmark of ~3.2/100k/yr (schema/response_benchmarks.csv B07, Weinberger et al. 2020).
rule.multi_county_basis: A state or multi-county jurisdiction is ready if at least 90% of its residents live in passing counties.
